summary: Iteration 74 - Newsletter Preferences Frontend UI + Public Unsubscribe Page: All features tested and working correctly. ProfilePage E-Mail-Einstellungen block loads preferences from GET /api/users/me/email-preferences, toggles work (newsletter, meeting invites), digest frequency select has 3 options (immediate/daily/weekly), save persists via PUT. UnsubscribePage (public, no auth) works: valid token shows email/status, confirm-unsubscribe-button sets newsletter_enabled=false, done screen shows resubscribe-after-unsub-button, invalid token shows error with login link. State sync verified: after unsubscribe via public page, ProfilePage shows newsletter toggle as OFF.

FRONTEND: ProfilePage.js - handleSavePrefs correctly sends PUT /users/me/email-preferences with newsletter_enabled, meeting_invites_enabled, digest_frequency

FRONTEND: UnsubscribePage.js - Uses axios directly with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (correct for public page without auth context)
FRONTEND: UnsubscribePage.js - State machine: loading -> ready/error, ready -> done_unsub/error, done_unsub -> done_resub/error

FRONTEND: UnsubscribePage.js - All data-testid attributes present: unsubscribe-page, unsubscribe-loading, unsubscribe-ready, unsubscribe-error, unsubscribe-done, resubscribe-done, unsubscribe-email, confirm-unsubscribe-button, resubscribe-button, resubscribe-after-unsub-button, unsubscribe-login-link, resub-login-link
FRONTEND: App.js - Route /unsubscribe/:token correctly configured as public (no ProtectedRoute wrapper)
BACKEND: routes/auth.py - GET/PUT /users/me/email-preferences endpoints work correctly with authentication
BACKEND: routes/auth.py - GET/POST /unsubscribe/{token} and POST /unsubscribe/{token}/resubscribe work correctly with HMAC-signed tokens (no auth required)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 74 tested Newsletter Preferences Frontend UI and Public Unsubscribe Page. Key findings: (1) ProfilePage E-Mail-Einstellungen block works correctly - loads preferences on mount, toggles work, digest frequency select has 3 options, save persists. (2) UnsubscribePage (public route /unsubscribe/:token) works correctly - shows email/status for valid token, confirm unsubscribe works, resubscribe-after-unsub works, invalid token shows error with login link. (3) State sync verified - after unsubscribe via public page, ProfilePage shows newsletter toggle as OFF. (4) Regression tests passed - profile name save, auto-reply toggle, avatar upload button all working. (5) Unsubscribe token generation: use HMAC-SHA256 with JWT_SECRET from backend/.env, payload is user_id, signature is first 12 bytes of HMAC digest, format is base64url(payload).base64url(sig).
